hero.description: I design software systems, technical solutions and engineering practices that help teams build scalable, maintainable products.

about.label: 01 — About
about.heading: Building software is only part of the job. Designing systems and helping teams build them well is the real challenge.
about.paragraph: More than 10 years of experience building software, currently at Lambda3 / Tivit. Acts as a technical reference, finding efficient solutions for product delivery across different scenarios, leading technical teams and promoting continuous improvement of daily processes. Backend specialist with Node.js, Nest.js and C#, focused on CI/CD, test automation and code readability, practicing agile development and DevOps best practices. Has worked across landing pages, web portals, dashboards, loyalty points systems, Pix and boleto payments, e-commerce and chatbot projects, and is now applying that experience to AI-assisted development.

items.description: Technical reference across the team, finding efficient solutions for product delivery in different scenarios. Leads technical teams, promotes feedback exchange and continuous improvement of daily processes. Backend specialist with a focus on CI/CD, test automation and code readability.
Backend development across C#, Node.js and TypeScript services, applying Hexagonal Architecture, SOLID and TDD, with a strong code review practice.
Built .NET templates and backend components using .NET Core, EF Core, Dapper, Fluent Validation and Quartz.
Web development spanning .NET Core, Entity Framework and SQL Server on the backend, with HTML, JavaScript and AngularJS on the frontend.
Built solutions with ASP.NET MVC, WCF, Web Services, Web Forms and Windows Forms.

work.label: 04 — Selected Work
work.heading: Engineering problems and architecture decisions, not just screenshots.

items.title: Portal & Dashboard Modernization
items.problem: Web portals and dashboards built on older stacks were becoming harder to extend safely.
items.architecture: Reverse engineering and modernization of legacy systems, rebuilding key modules on a cleaner architecture.
items.outcome: Systems that are easier to change and extend without breaking existing behavior.

items.title: Loyalty Points Platform
items.problem: A points-based loyalty system needed clear rules and room to grow without becoming tangled.
items.architecture: Designed a modular backend architecture separating rules, accounting and integrations into distinct boundaries.
items.outcome: A platform that can add new loyalty rules and partner integrations without reworking the core.

items.title: E-commerce & Payments (Pix / Boleto)
items.problem: An e-commerce platform needed reliable checkout with local payment methods like Pix and boleto.
items.architecture: Designed scalable services on AWS and Azure to handle catalog, checkout and payment processing.
items.outcome: A checkout flow that handles local payment methods reliably at scale.

items.title: CI/CD & Test Automation
items.problem: Manual releases and inconsistent testing were slowing delivery across projects.
items.architecture: Built CI/CD pipelines and automated test suites, embedding TDD and code review into the team's workflow.
items.outcome: Faster, more consistent releases with fewer regressions reaching production.
